archetypes.name: state-handoff
archetypes.rationale: Targets the multi-hop SCOPE_ANCHOR_FILE propagation contract where a missed parse, emit, or env write could invalidate the proposed design.
archetypes.prompt_body: Trace the proposed SCOPE_ANCHOR_FILE flow across tally-plan-review, plan-review-loop, run-step3-review, SKILL.md, and approval-gates.md against the repo evidence. Look for missing argv plumbing, parse allowlists, result-env persistence, stale-value behavior, and mismatches between prose contracts and script behavior. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.

archetypes.name: trust-boundary
archetypes.rationale: Focuses on whether the plan consistently converts user-controlled scope and context content into framed, redacted, escaped evidence before SECURITY.md claims coverage.
archetypes.prompt_body: Audit the proposed trust-boundary changes for scope-anchor, assessor feature files, waterfall plan/findings blocks, and Claude subprocess context files. Compare each promised consumer surface to existing helpers and tests, and flag any raw-content path, incomplete framing prose, overbroad SECURITY.md claim, or delimiter-escaping inconsistency. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.

archetypes.name: harness-matrix
archetypes.rationale: Checks whether the named regression tests actually cover every proposed behavior and edge case rather than merely listing harnesses.
archetypes.prompt_body: Map each planned code or documentation change to the corresponding test harness assertions and edge cases in the scope file list. Look for missing negative cases, absent stale-state checks, stdin/file parity gaps, CR/LF usage errors, empty-anchor fallbacks, and tests that would pass without proving the intended contract. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
